The nine special cyclic7 orbits (a_beta,b_alpha,v_4,v_5,v_6) are ONBs of their7-dimensional spans. Fourier inversion of their Gram matrix forces every one of the seven character projections to have squared norm1/7. Thus all seven characters occur; each orbit uses one line per character and its corner complement has dimensions m_k-1.

A simple eigenspace m_k=1 cannot contain any corner ray, since every special orbit already spans it. Hence all corner rays lie in the sum of eigenspaces with multiplicity at least2. With total dimension10, the three possible excess partitions are3;2+1;1+1+1, giving available corner dimensions4,5,6 respectively.

The3x3 corner graph of row/column/M orthogonality is K_(3,3,3), partitioned by L=beta-alpha. Distinct corner rays in each of its three nonadjacent classes require rank at least2 in each class; the three class spans are pairwise orthogonal, so total rank at least6. Only excess1+1+1 survives.

In the surviving three2-dimensional eigenspaces, each corner L-class has span exactly2. A2-space split over distinct eigenvalues has only two eigenlines, so cannot contain three distinct corner eigenrays. Thus each entire corner L-class occupies one doubled character. Its three actual CP1 lines may vary; the special orbit projection line in that character is their context-wise orthogonal complement, never an independent phase choice.

All ordinary rows reduce exactly to unitarity of [v_0,...,v_6,a_0,a_1,a_2]. All ordinary columns reduce to [v_0,T^-1 v_1,...,T^-6 v_6,b_0,b_1,b_2]. All ordinary M classes reduce to [T^-1 v_0,v_1,T^-6 v_2,T^-5 v_3,T^-2 a_0,T^-3 a_1,T^-4 a_2,T^-3 b_0,T^-5 b_1,b_2]. The nine special contexts reduce to the cyclic-orbit character norms plus the ACTUAL corner-complement lines. These are finite-amplitude equations, not a tangent or second-order jet.

The full target further requires all13 noncorner orbit representatives to have projectively free7-orbits and no two to be phase/T-shift equivalent, and all9 corner rays distinct. No root satisfying the three ordinary unitarities and all those separation inequalities has yet been constructed.
